defects.title: Reaction-indexed fields are permuted along the wrong dimension when another dimension has the same size
defects.trigger: model = createModel({'R1','R2','R3'}, {'R1','R2','R3'}, {'A -> B','B -> C','C -> '}); model2 = moveRxn(model, 1, 3) (square S); likewise 3 constraints (C 3 x 3) or a custom 3 x 3 field rxnPair
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-23) model2.rxns = {'R2','R3','R1'} but model2.S == model.S([2 3 1],:) (metabolite rows moved, columns unchanged); model2.C == C([2 3 1],:); custom 3 x 3 rxnPair == rxnPair([2 3 1],:) (columns not moved). Line 42 checks size(field,1) first and ignores the dimensions output of getModelFieldsForType (which gives 2 for S and C)
defects.expected: model2.S == model.S(:,[2 3 1]), model2.C == C(:,[2 3 1]); a reaction x reaction field moved in both dimensions

notes: No testMoveRxn.m existed; the grep for 'moveRxn(' only hits removeRxns( in testLegacy/testModelManipulationOri.m (its moveRxn lines 484-485 are commented out) and tutorialDerived/tutorial_modelManipulation.m (moveRxn(model,8,1), a tutorial, not a test of moveRxn alone), so a new file was written. Folder testRefinement chosen (holds testGetModelFieldsForType; testModelManipulation also holds refinement tests). Reproduction (MATLAB): model = createModel({'R1','R2','R3'}, {'R1','R2','R3'}, {'A -> B','B -> C','C -> '}); m2 = moveRxn(model,1,3); isequal(full(m2.S), full(model.S([2 3 1],:))) -> 1, isequal(full(m2.S), full(model.S(:,[2 3 1]))) -> 0. Constraint case: model = createModel({'R1','R2','R3'}, {'R1','R2','R3'}, {'A -> B','B -> C','C -> D'}); model.C = sparse([1 2 3;4 5 6;7 8 9]); model.d = zeros(3,1); model.ctrs = {'c1';'c2';'c3'}; model.dsense = 'EEE'; model.ctrNames = model.ctrs; m4 = moveRxn(model,1,3) -> full(m4.C) = [4 5 6;7 8 9;1 2 3]. Custom field: same 4-met model, model.rxnPair = reshape(1:9,3,3); moveRxn(model,1,3).rxnPair = [2 5 8;3 6 9;1 4 7]. Non-square models (m ~= n, ctrs ~= n) look correct from the code; the defect is in moveRxn itself, not in getModelFieldsForType (which now returns S and C with dimension 2 correctly; the 2026-11-23 fix is not involved). No src/ function calls moveRxn, so the quarantine blocks no caller. Registry regenerated (python3 .github/scripts/known_defects.py: Wrote test/known-defects.md).
confirmed_by: lead (read the code: line 42 tests size(field,1) == numel(rxns) before size(field,2), so a square S or C is permuted by rows; reproduced in MATLAB R2025a 2026-11-23 with a 3 x 3 model: moved S equals S([2 3 1],:), not S(:,[2 3 1]))
